lines.text: Did you know? Flect is Latin for bend.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus bend?

words.ex: The ball must be deflected before its path will change.
We saw our reflection in the water.
The job offers flexibility in working hours and the option to work remotely.

publish.title: Flect root: deflect, reflection and flexibility
publish.value: Flect comes from Latin "flectere" (to bend). Words: deflect, reflection and flexibility. deflect = de + flect; reflection = re + flect.
